save.text: Liam is joining remotely via Internet/‘Digital Liam’ and can be heard; appeared on Twitch feed.
Matt and Marisha will be guests at Tekko in Pittsburgh, weekend of the 8th–10th; panels and signings.
Gilmore’s Glorious Goods shirt pre-order deadline confusion: may end “tomorrow night,” but to be safe they told viewers to order tonight.
Liam is remote (“Digital Liam”), audible; now noted he’s at his childhood home kitchen, first room he ever played D&D in.
Marisha: her last episode as Signal Boost host airs this Tuesday; she still produces the show and hosts rotate.
Gilmore’s Glorious Goods shirt pre-order deadline confusion: may end “tomorrow night,” but to be safe they told viewers to order tonight.
Scanlan casts Mordenkainen’s Magnificent Mansion for shelter; can admit designated creatures, even entire Pyrah tribe (~35 incl. Zephrah).
Vex entered the Mansion first and described lush foyer with ethereal servants; Grog attacked servants, dispersing a few.
Scanlan’s first time casting MMM; boasts 100 attendants, rooms (kitchen, parlor, game room, billiards, music room); 5 assigned to play during meals.
Scanlan confirms MMM is a newly acquired skill; says 100 servants, 50 assigned to him; individual rooms for all, his largest; adjacent rooms reserved for Pike and Kaylie.
Ethereal servants are obedient, call Scanlan “Master”; claim service is their purpose; can conjure food/drink inside, which dissipates when taken outside the mansion.
Grog receives chilled wine; can high-five servant (slightly cushy). Party debates ethics of ‘slave ghosts’; Vex distrusts Scanlan re: spying.
Keyleth brings in a few Pyrah survivors into MMM; servants assist; some continue building outside for post-departure lodging.
MMM entry is invite-only; cast once per day; casting time 1 minute so not mid-battle escape.
Servants can fetch/create some spectral items (e.g., a spectral cow existed); limited resources; conjured creations disperse, no blood if struck.
MMM has a basement training room: sand pit, wooden dummies, chains for climbing/lifting, basic weapons and armor racks; doorway to it can appear as needed.
Vex retrieved a broom from the Bag of Holding and tried command words to fly; it did nothing and she put it back, implying the broom is non-flying or requires other activation.
Trinket practiced a charging attack on Grog in the MMM gym; +8 attack bonus, hit AC 23 for 7 bludgeoning; Grog made STR save (26), not knocked prone.

Scanlan investigated Vex’s stolen broom; Arcana 14 revealed it needs a spoken command; Investigation 21 found hidden Draconic word; Vex (who reads Draconic) read archaic Draconic for “candle,” activating the broom to fly.
Previously-nonfunctional broom from Bag of Holding was activated by Vex saying the archaic Draconic word for “candle”; it is indeed a flying broom with a command word.
MMM ceilings in Scanlan’s top-floor room are ~50 ft high; extradimensional, with garish drapery.
Vex successfully flies the broom using the same archaic Draconic command; practices maneuvering; remains exhausted but passes a Dex check (20).
Cerkonos visits Keyleth at night; his previously lost arm is visibly regenerating; he feels uneasy and requests to talk privately.

Cerkonos privately warns Keyleth: a Pyrah initiate named Raishan (arrived ~age 15; appeared human but uncertain) secretly wielded ancient arcane, tore open the Pyrah Gate months ago, releasing Thordak; Cerkonos was defeated; he feels guilty and urges caution/trust instincts.
Raishan is identified as the green dragon of the Chroma Conclave that attacked Emon; Keyleth recognizes the name and plans to listen for info and send word if found.
Vax’s dream: Raven Queen appears, calls him fate-touched and ‘my champion’; presents choices (rebirth/ruin; maker/martyr; conqueror/tyrant/nothing) then snaps his thread; he falls into darkness.
Breakfast in Scanlan’s mansion; question raised if items persist after leaving—unknown (not tested).
Vex admits she stole Gern’s flying broom (necromancer/candlemaker); revealed to group and intends to keep it; she can fly.
Grog’s nightmare: atop a throne of corpses; Kevdak and the Herd kneel; Kevdak says he’s proud; Grog wakes shaken as party finishes long rest.
Vex practices flying on Gern’s stolen broom during breakfast; can hover hands-free with difficulty; hits a thrown chicken once, misses another; plans to practice more.
Breakfast in Scanlan’s mansion; Vex tests broom; item persistence still untested/unknown.
Keyleth objects to Vex’s broom on safety/greed grounds; Vex says she’s not afraid to die after having died; group reluctantly accepts if she’s careful.
Percy agrees to engineer a seat/stabilizer for Vex’s broom; may need funding, Vex will pay.
Breakfast still in Scanlan’s mansion; endless chicken/waffles due to his commands; vegetables absent; Scanlan forgot to bring party to-do list.

Keyleth reports from Cerkonos: Raishan infiltrated Fire Ashari at Pyrah disguised as a 15-year-old human ~4 years ago; exceeded druidic powers; opened the rift; tied to Thordak; Ashari didn’t know she was a dragon.
Party next steps debated: options include Grog’s tribe for Titanstone Knuckles (Kevdak) or visiting a sphinx’s partner; library also considered; Grog noncommittal on timing.
Group decides to head toward Westruun; targets: Grog’s herd (Titanstone Knuckles) and possibly sphinx’s mate south of Frostweald; library deprioritized.
Grog’s herd roams Silvercut Roadway region: west of Westruun, south of Kraghammer, east of Emon (per Matt). Potential conflict expected due to Grog’s past exile.

Grog’s backstory: opposed killing a small bearded traveler; uncle forced duel—Grog beat cousin, then uncle beat Grog and left him for dead; herd likely thinks he’s dead; Knuckles owned by uncle Kevdak; Grog refuses to hide with Hat of Disguise.
Party shifts: plan sphinx first (Frostweald) before confronting Grog’s uncle/Knucles; Cobalt Reserve in Westruun deemed looted by Allura.
Travel notes: Keyleth can Tree Stride but recalls no specific Frostweald tree (INT 9); options to scry or use nearby trees—Crossroads on Silvercut, Bramblewood north of Westruun.
Westruun area status: Umbrasyl (black dragon) lairs in Gatshadow north of Westruun; city under dragon rule/observation.
Route choice: Switched from Crossroads to Bramblewood entrance near Westruun; Keyleth recalled/connected to marked tree there and Tree Strided party to Bramblewood.
Westruun vicinity: No wyverns seen in scry; party flew as Wind Walk south of Bramblewood; spotted a 15–20 ft disturbed dirt mound with wooden spikes, glints, grooves; two people carting away from it.
Travel status: From Bramblewood, Frostweald ~1.5–2 days on foot; Wind Walk chosen (faster than horses) to travel toward Frostweald after teleporting to Bramblewood.

Westruun outskirts mound: Investigation (Percy 18, Vex 16) found sweeping large fast claw marks; offerings site with smattering of gold/silver coins; wooden pieces crushed; idea voiced to set an ambush later.

Westruun outskirts reconnaissance: Many burned farmlands and some active; each working group watched by a well-armed guard who abuses workers; thin additional wall/battlements at city entrances; party landed in high-crop field, cast Pass Without a Trace, all reverted and stealthed successfully (high rolls).
Debate: freeing farmers now risks starvation or reprisals; plan focus shifts to learning/defeating dragon before acting in town.

Farmer Reginald (bruised) confirms: workers oppressed by dragon’s servants; many captives incl. his daughter; captors include half-orcs; some slaves slaughtered as warnings; he points to a nearby outskirt guard post and generally to the city for prisoners.
Dragon sightings: flies over once every couple days; last seen dusk yesterday (~half-day ago).
